parsed.g: Show the customers who have expressed dissatisfaction with the Antonia racer tank product by finding relevant reviews in the Magento admin panel.
P_t: Navigated to Marketing > User Content > All Reviews page
Entered 'Antonia racer tank' in the Product filter field
Applied search filter with product name 'Antonia racer tank' and review text 'not useful'
R_t: Clear the incorrect 'not useful' text from the Review filter field and search only by product name 'Antonia racer tank' to find all reviews (including negative/dissatisfied ones) for that product
Identify customers who expressed dissatisfaction from the filtered review results
parsed.e_t: The agent is on the Reviews page at http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/review/product/index/filter/... with two active filters: Product field contains 'Antonia racer tank' and the Review text field contains 'not useful'. The result shows '0 records found' and 'We couldn't find any records.' The filter row shows the Review column cell [83784] has 'not useful' as a persistent filter value, and the Product column cell [83827] shows 'Antonia racer tank'. The Type combobox [83808] has no type filter selected (empty option selected). The Status combobox [83759] also has no filter selected.
C: The 'not useful' text in the Review filter is causing zero results — this filter is incorrectly applied and needs to be cleared
The correct approach is to filter only by product name 'Antonia racer tank' without the 'not useful' review text filter
Dissatisfaction should be interpreted from low ratings or negative review content, not from a literal 'not useful' text match

F_t.action: Typed 'Antonia racer tank' in product filter and searched with 'not useful' already in the Review field
F_t.cause: The Review filter field [3058] already contained 'not useful' text from a previous session/state, causing the combined filter to return 0 records. The 'not useful' text does not match any review content for this product.
Search executed with both 'not useful' in Review field and 'Antonia racer tank' in Product field, returning 0 records because no reviews contain the literal text 'not useful' for this product.

Clicking the combobox opened the dropdown but did not change the filter value — the 'Customer' option was not successfully selected as shown by the combobox still showing empty selection in subsequent steps.
The click did not register a selection change — subsequent DOM shows the Type combobox still has empty option selected, and results remain 0 records.

F_t.action: Multiple repeated Search button clicks across steps 10, 11, 12, 17, 18
F_t.cause: Each search was executed with the 'not useful' text still present in the Review filter field, consistently returning 0 records because no reviews match that literal text for the Antonia racer tank product.

F_t.action: Clicked Type combobox [52963] and then 'Customer' option [52976]
F_t.cause: The dropdown opened (expanded: True shown in step 14 DOM) but the Customer option click at step 14 did not persist — subsequent DOM shows Type combobox still has empty option selected.

K_t: The Reviews page is accessible via Marketing > User Content > All Reviews at URL http://172.185.52.29:7780/admin/review/product/index/
The Review filter field has a persistent 'not useful' value that was never cleared, causing all searches to return 0 results
The product filter field correctly contains 'Antonia racer tank'
The filter URL encodes 'detail=not+useful&name=Antonia+racer+tank' confirming both filters are active
To find dissatisfied customers, the 'not useful' text in the Review filter must be cleared first, then search only by product name
The Reviews table has columns: ID, Created, Status, Title, Nickname, Review, Visibility, Type, Product, SKU, Action
The Nickname column would show the customer name/nickname who wrote the review
The Type filter dropdown has options: (empty), Administrator, Customer, Guest — filtering by 'Customer' would show only customer-submitted reviews
